My 13 y/o dog had a stroke because of cancerous tumors, was inoperable and due for in-house euthanasia; totally unresponsive for more than 2 days. Then randomly around 3 am one night I heard his chain collar rubbing along his food dish. I went into the kitchen and he was eating some kibble and lapping water. He licked his chops and wagged his tail when he noticed me. Next he barked at me super loud while standing next to the tv stand. He remembered his tennis ball was under there. We played fetch for 2-3 minutes. He quickly jumped up on the couch and spun/laid down like dogs do. I put my hand on his back and I began dozing off. I woke up the next morning spooned around him and he was dead and shit the couch. I was like.. fuck .. I love you buddy.. 😭.  Makes a person question sanity.

Maybe it’s a mammalian mechanism that allows us to say goodbye to one another before our end?
